channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nate McMillan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nate McMillan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins
item.description:
Payton shared with Poole and Johnson.

“We used to go fishing when my mom was pregnant with my brother. Detlef [Schrempf], Hersey [Hawkins]. Those were all of [Gary Sr.’s] teammates. Nate McMillan, Damon Stoudamire– [Jason] Kidd is like family, too. [Brian] Shaw is family. Big [Shaquille O'Neal]. Rest in peace Kobe [Bryant]. Kobe was around back then. I can literally go on. Bonzie Wells.”

Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins, Dec 19, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Nate McMillan:

“He has see change and he's done a great job of adapting.”

Dwane Casey on Nate McMillan, Oct 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Hawks GMTravis Schlenk on Nate McMillan’s future as coach:

“We have an agreement in place in principle with Nate. We’re just drawing up the contract.”

Travis Schlenk on Nate McMillan, Jul 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Cam Reddish on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Cam Reddish on his relationship with Nate McMillan:

“It felt good to just feel like he was on my side. I'm always going to have his back for sure. Good dude, great relationship.”

Cam Reddish on Nate McMillan, Jul 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Bogdanovic on Nate McMillan's influence:

“The coaching was a crucial part of our success. There’s a lot of teams that are talented in the league but they’re not under control. I think he put a little control in this team and he helped us get these wins”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Nate McMillan, May 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on firing McMillan:

“In any major move this organization makes ultimately I'm going to consult with Herb. ... The buck stops with me. That was on me. It was my decision. I take full responsibility for that. ... Put it on me.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan, Aug 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on why he reversed course and fired McMillan:

“You have a gut feeling now is the time. I had a feeling, 'Now is the time'”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan, Aug 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Nate McMillan's firing:

“It's on other people to decide what they want to do with their organization ... I don't know that anyone has gotten more out of his team the last 3-4 years than Nate McMillan.”

Brad Stevens on Nate McMillan, Aug 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @SIChrisMannix.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Nate McMillan's firing in Indiana:

“It's just shocking to me. It's very hard to comprehend.... I don't know what the organization's philosophical reasons were, but I know Nate McMillan is one of the most respected coaches in the league.”

Rick Carlisle on Nate McMillan, Aug 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on extending Nate McMillan’s contract:

“What Nate has done in four seasons with our franchise merits this extension. Between injuries and changes in personnel, he and his coaching staff have adapted and produced positive results.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate McMillan, Aug 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Corliss Williamson
item.description:
“The thing about Jason that kept me to have an open mind immediately is that the lead assistant role on my staff, I’ve always tried to fill with a former player, a former respected player that has coaching experiencedating back to Brian Shaw first, initially, and then onto Nate McMillan, and then Corliss Williamson on my coaching staff in Orlando,”

Frank Vogel on Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Corliss Williamson, Jul 28, 2019. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Nate McMillan
item.description:
“Coach McMillan really stressed to us to shoot those 3s and avoid mid-to-long 2s,”

Doug McDermott on Nate McMillan, Oct 14, 2018. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: JJ Redick on Nate McMillan
item.description:
JJ Redick:

“I almost signed with Indy. I was an hour away, two hours away, I was very close. I had a 5:00 PM deadline... it was 12:30, 1:00 in the afternoon when Philly changed the offer... I had a whole conversation with Nate McMillan.”

JJ Redick on Nate McMillan, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Dwane Casey, Kyle Lowry, Nate McMillan
item.description:
“With Kyle Lowry and DeRozan and Dwane Casey who's done a great job this year of changing the offense, being way better defensively, we knew it was going to be a tough matchup for us. But I do think that first round, Nate McMillan and his Pacers, they really did a good job of preparing us for this series.”

Tyronn Lue on Dwane Casey, Kyle Lowry, Nate McMillan, May 5, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
James Worthy:

“It’s funny, with so many players coming out of high school and one year of college, you're starting to see teams wanting college coaches and stuff like that, but right off the top of my head: I played with Byron Scott, so I know what he brings to the table. I know that he holds people accountable and he’s a defensive kind of genius when it comes to that. I like Nate McMillan. Nate McMillan spent some time with Coach K [Mike Krzyzewski] in USA/international basketball. I think he knows all the players that were on the team. He has a good rapport. But, I got to go with my good friend Byron Scott, if it was up to me.”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski, May 20, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Nate McMillan
item.description:
“I'm going to them and trying to talk to them, but they were blowing me off. They are like, 'What do you know about this?' They had something against (McMillan), and you know how it is when you have a grudge, and there's a guy getting everything he wants? You are not going to listen to him. That's how it was.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Nate McMillan, Apr 28, 2012. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Nate McMillan
item.description:
“The best example I have is Nate McMillan. All the success that he had up there (in Portland), dragging those teams through all the injuries and everything. He had two-and-a-half bad weeks and they fire him. I mean, that to me, I don't understand it. But that's, I guess, I shouldn't be in somebody else's business.”

Kevin O'Connor on Nate McMillan, Apr 27, 2012. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Raymond Felton on Nate McMillan
item.description:
“It was nothing personal between me and him. I have a lot of love for Coach Nate. “I will say I was more uptight (under McMillan). You have a hard-nosed coach trying to get used to the point guard, and a point guard who is trying to get used to the coach. That’s all it was. Me and Coach Nate needed more time with each other. Everybody was rushing through the season trying to play games without much practice time.”

Raymond Felton on Nate McMillan, Apr 9, 2012. Source: Portland Tribune.

item.title: Luke Babbitt on Nate McMillan, Kaleb Canales
item.description:
Luke Babbitt on whether Kaleb Canales is more player-friendly than Nate McMillan:

“I want to be careful with how I say that but they definitely have different styles. I'll just say that everyone likes Kaleb. He's a guy that has everyone's respect. We're trying to play hard for him. That's about it.”

Luke Babbitt on Nate McMillan, Kaleb Canales, Mar 30, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Raymond Felton on Nate McMillan
item.description:
Felton spoke with CSNNW.com about Nate McMillan's decision to bench him a day after the team suffered an embarrassing franchise-low 7-point opening quarter; they eventually lost to the Los Angeles Lakers 103-92.

“He (Nate McMillan) called me this morning and told me we got to have consistency from that position and that a 7-point quarter was unacceptable,”

Raymond Felton on Nate McMillan, Feb 21, 2012. Source: CSNNW.com.
